title: Gate asymmetry verified: STATE_FINAL_OUTPUT correctly NOT popped; both pops match the established clear-before-re-judge pattern
evidence: ctx.session.state.pop(STATE_VERIFICATION_COMPLIANCE_REVIEW, None) (agent.py:596); ctx.session.state.pop(STATE_FINAL_COMPLIANCE_REVIEW, None) (agent.py:686); "The slot cleared here is STATE_FINAL_COMPLIANCE_REVIEW (the reviewer's verdict), NOT STATE_FINAL_OUTPUT (the audited v4 payload the scrubber mutates in place — clearing that would empty the reviewer's `{final_output}` placeholder)" (agent.py:680-683); "running the reviewer on stale / empty STATE_FINAL_OUTPUT would only waste a call (its instruction returns passed=true on empty input" (agent.py:668-670)
detail: Both gates pop the correct keys; STATE_FINAL_OUTPUT is rightly untouched — the reviewer auto-passes on empty input, so popping it would bypass the audit. Top-of-attempt placement (not finally) preserves the last-attempt review finalize escalates.
recommended_fix: No change. Keep the asymmetry and inline warnings; do not harmonize into popping STATE_FINAL_OUTPUT.
